coverage_gaps.description: Statutory registers reliably expose the single legal signatory (керівник), but not the wider management board, C-level hires, or regular staff hiring — the bulk of A5 'jobs and hiring' interest.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pair this pointer cell with job-board, LinkedIn-style and corporate-newsroom cells; treat registers as the confirmation and timing layer only.

coverage_gaps.description: The highest-value real-time capability — an event stream of ЄДР director changes filtered to banks and payment providers — sits behind commercial APIs (Opendatabot, VKURSI, YouControl), not behind a free public endpoint.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Budget for one licensed aggregator API plus a free open-data dump diff as an independent cross-check and continuity fallback.

coverage_gaps.description: Refresh cadence of the data.gov.ua ЄДР bulk dump was not established in this pass, so the achievable detection latency of a director change via the free route is unknown.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch the dataset resource metadata and measure the actual publication interval before choosing between free-dump diffing and paid monitoring.

coverage_gaps.description: No single register was found that jointly enumerates banks and all non-bank payment service providers with a common identifier; the bank register, the payment infrastructure register and the NSSMC licensee lists must be joined manually.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build an internal entity master keyed on EDRPOU that merges the NBU State Register of Banks dataset, the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури and NSSMC licensee lists.

coverage_gaps.description: Person-name matching across Ukrainian originals and English transliterations of banking executives has no authoritative crosswalk; only OpenSanctions offers partial entity resolution.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Adopt a documented transliteration standard plus an alias table seeded from OpenSanctions ext_ua_edr, and validate against known bank board members.

brief: For Ukraine, the statutory-register layer is unusually strong for leadership-move intelligence: a director change is legally constituted by its entry in the ЄДР, so the Ministry of Justice register (free search, plus a full bulk open-data dump on data.gov.ua administered by NAIS) is the earliest and most authoritative signal, ahead of any press release. Above it sits a mandatory disclosure stream — «особлива інформація» on «зміна складу посадових осіб» filed to SMIDA/stockmarket.gov.ua — which adds named, dated, narrative detail for banks that are securities issuers, while the NBU State Register of Banks and the Реєстр платіжної інфраструктури define the entity universe that these diffs must be filtered against. The practical bottleneck is not availability but operationalisation: turning a register snapshot into a change event is a commercial product (Opendatabot, YouControl, Clarity Project, VKURSI), and both bank.gov.ua and opendatabot.ua returned 403 to plain fetchers, so collection must assume browser-grade access or licensed APIs. Registers cover the legal signatory only, so this cell should be read as the confirmation-and-timing backbone for A5 rather than a source of hiring or staffing signal.
